The '''garbage hunters''' were [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creatures native to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] planet [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]]. The species evolved in response to the planet's extremely polluted environment and serves as a striking example of how scale and surroundings can shape evolution. Garbage hunters thrived in filthy urban zones, which were also plagued by [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]] infestations. Roughly 2 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and waist-high to a [[Human/Legends|Human]], they resembled other four-legged rodents but bore a chitinous ridge along their backs that rose an additional meter above the spine. As a result, a garbage hunter burrowing through waste heaps resembled an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] predator gliding through [[Water/Legends|water]], closing in on prey with only the slightest warning. Possessing darkvision up to 20 meters, they hunted efficiently in low-light conditions, combining agility, strength, and keen survival instincts to dominate the urban wastelands.
